title: Essential surjectivity of the concrete geometric-point functor
statement: Let K be a field [def-pc-field-extension], Ksep a separable closure, and G=Gal(Ksep/K) with its Krull topology. Let P take an etale K-scheme X [def-weil-etale-morphism] to Hom_K(Spec Ksep,X), with its continuous discrete G-action [lem-exc-etale-field-geometric-action-continuous], and take a map to postcomposition. Then every discrete continuous G-set is isomorphic to P(X) for some etale K-scheme X.

source.place: Tag 03QR, Lemma lemma-sheaves-point; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03QR; construction of an inverse by orbit stabilizer fixed fields

proof.text: Decompose a discrete continuous G-set S into G-orbits and choose a point in each nonempty orbit. Each stabilizer H is open by continuity and discreteness. The Galois group is compact, and its quotient by an open subgroup is finite (Mathlib Subgroup.quotient_finite_of_isOpen); thus every orbit is finite.

Apply [lem-exc-etale-field-galois-classification] to each finite transitive orbit. Its stabilizer fixed field is a finite separable extension L of K, and the orbit is equivariantly isomorphic to the set of K-embeddings L -> Ksep. The chosen orbit representatives and the quotient orbit index set have universe u, so the coproduct remains a Scheme in universe u.

Each Spec L is etale over K by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-separable-extension-etale]. Form their coproduct, whose structure map is etale by [lem-exc-etale-coproduct-etale]. Spec Ksep is a singleton scheme, so any geometric point of this coproduct factors uniquely through a component. Its geometric-point G-set is therefore the disjoint union of the embedding G-sets, equivariantly isomorphic to S. Empty S gives the empty coproduct.
